title: Automate or Assist? The Role of Computational Models in Identifying Gendered Discourse in US Capital Trial Transcripts

bias_targets.methodology: Finetuning LEGAL-BERT classifiers on expert-annotated US capital trial transcripts to identify four themes of gendered discourse (Emotions, Hypersexualization, Betrayal of Gender Norms, and Bad Mother), combined with coreference resolution and expert qualitative evaluation of model-human disagreements.
